examples.trans: This is the restaurant's signature dish.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought
не в моём вкусе = not my type
at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
to choose, select; to use up completely (quotas, limits)

examples.text: В этом году все квоты выбрали.
examples.trans: This year all the quotas have been used up.
She chose the most beautiful dress.

выполнять.gloss: to perform, to carry out, to do (an exercise)

meanings.en: to perform, to execute, to carry out (an exercise, task, or order)

examples.trans: Girls, don't sleep, do the exercise!
He always completes his work on time.

meanings.note: 'закрывать глаза на' + accusative = to turn a blind eye to

examples.text: Я не буду закрывать на это глаза.
examples.trans: I'm not going to close my eyes to this.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: mostly in set phrases: иметь совесть, иметь право = to have the right; everyday 'I have' is у меня есть

examples.trans: You have the right to remain silent.
I'm working with clients right now.
This is only for regular clients.
They have a very beautiful house.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world
в любой момент = at any moment

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: usually in short form обязан/обязана + dative + instrumental

examples.trans: You are obliged to come on time.

meanings.note: с первого раза = the first time

examples.text: Ты не понимаешь с первого раза?
examples.trans: You don't understand the first time?

meanings.note: платить за + accusative = to pay for

посидеть.gloss: to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)

meanings.note: посиди с ним = stay with him

examples.trans: Stay with Vika for a while.
Let's sit in a café for a bit.
Why are we going so slowly?
She had a right to the flat.
What did you bring into the flat?

examples.text: Я приношу бутылку шампанского и свечи.
examples.trans: I'll bring a bottle of champagne and candles.

examples.text: И не надо больше никаких документов сюда приносить!
examples.trans: And don't bring any more documents in here!

присесть.gloss: to sit down (for a moment), to take a seat

meanings.en: to sit down, to have a seat

examples.trans: He sat down on the chair.

meanings.note: у нас к вам просьба = we have a request for you

examples.trans: We have a request for you.

examples.text: У меня к тебе маленькая просьба.
examples.trans: I have a small favour to ask of you.
A plot next to Grigory Soprykin.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Why are you sitting in the corner?
They are building a shopping centre.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)
to leave, to go away (on foot)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
